etk854hybrid_cycleEdrive.title: ETK 854: EV Mode
etk854hybrid_cycleEdrive.desc: Cycle AUTO EV / MAX EV / BATTERY CONTROL

etk854hybrid_setComfort.title: ETK 854: COMFORT
etk854hybrid_setComfort.desc: Linear pedal map, balanced hybrid strategy, sailing on

etk854hybrid_setEcoPro.title: ETK 854: ECO PRO
etk854hybrid_setEcoPro.desc: Degressive pedal map, maximum efficiency, sailing on

etk854hybrid_setSportDE.title: ETK 854: SPORT
etk854hybrid_setSportDE.desc: Progressive pedal map, ICE always on, E-boost, no sailing

etk854hybrid_setAutoEdrive.title: ETK 854: AUTO EV
etk854hybrid_setAutoEdrive.desc: Electric up to ~110 km/h, ICE on kickdown or high load

etk854hybrid_setMaxEdrive.title: ETK 854: MAX EV
etk854hybrid_setMaxEdrive.desc: Purely electric, the ICE stays off even on kickdown (only the battery protection below 8 % SOC starts it)

etk854hybrid_setBatteryControl.title: ETK 854: BATTERY CONTROL
etk854hybrid_setBatteryControl.desc: Hold / charge the battery to the target SOC

etk854hybrid_targetSocUp.title: ETK 854: Target SOC +10%
etk854hybrid_targetSocUp.desc: Raise the BATTERY CONTROL charge target

etk854hybrid_targetSocDown.title: ETK 854: Target SOC -10%
etk854hybrid_targetSocDown.desc: Lower the BATTERY CONTROL charge target

etk854hybrid_cycleRegen.title: ETK 854: Recuperation Level
etk854hybrid_cycleRegen.desc: Cycle OFF / LOW / MED / HIGH (OFF = sailing, HIGH = one-pedal driving)

etk854hybrid_launchArm.title: ETK 854: Launch Control
etk854hybrid_launchArm.desc: Arm / disarm launch control (S/M, or D in SPORT; SPORT+DTC: brake + kickdown)

etk854hybrid_cycleShiftProgram.onDown: local m = package.loaded['controller/vehicleController/shiftLogic/etk854hybrid_8hp'] or package.loaded['controller/shiftLogic-etk854hybrid_8hp'] if type(m) ~= 'table' or type(m.setProgram) ~= 'function' or type(m.getProgram) ~= 'function' then return end local _, p, o = m.getProgram() local l = {'AUTO', 'ECO', 'COMFORT', 'SPORT', 'MANUAL'} local c = (p == 'MANUAL') and 'MANUAL' or (o or 'AUTO') local i = 1 for k = 1, 5 do if l[k] == c then i = k end end local n = l[i % 5 + 1] local g = powertrain.getDevice('gearbox') if n == 'MANUAL' and not (g and (g.gearIndex or 0) >= 1 and m.setProgram('MANUAL')) then n = 'AUTO' end if n ~= 'MANUAL' then m.setProgram(n) end guihooks.message('ETK 854 shift program: ' .. (n == 'AUTO' and 'AUTO (follows drive mode)' or n), 3, 'vehicle.etk854hybrid.shiftProgram')
etk854hybrid_cycleShiftProgram.title: ETK 854: Shift Program
etk854hybrid_cycleShiftProgram.desc: Cycle the shift program: AUTO (follows drive mode) / ECO / COMFORT / SPORT / MANUAL (M gate, only with a forward gear engaged)

etk854hybrid_cycleMode.title: ETK 854: Cycle Preset
etk854hybrid_cycleMode.desc: Legacy preset cycle AUTO / HYBRID / EV / HOLD / SPORT

etk854hybrid_setHybrid.title: ETK 854: Preset HYBRID
etk854hybrid_setHybrid.desc: COMFORT + AUTO EV with the ICE pinned on

etk854hybrid_toggleTrailerMode.title: ETK 854: Trailer Mode
etk854hybrid_toggleTrailerMode.desc: Trailer mode ON/OFF (self-leveling + firmer damping); activates automatically when a trailer is hitched

etk854hybrid_toggleAwdMode.title: ETK 854: xAllrad AWD / 2WD
etk854hybrid_toggleAwdMode.desc: Toggle xAllrad all-wheel drive and rear-wheel drive (AWD configs only)

etk854hybrid_cdMenu.title: ETK 854: Centre display menu
etk854hybrid_cdMenu.desc: Open / close the settings panel on the centre display

etk854hybrid_cdPrev.title: ETK 854: Controller rotate left
etk854hybrid_cdPrev.desc: Settings panel: previous tab / item (opens the panel when it is closed)

etk854hybrid_cdNext.title: ETK 854: Controller rotate right
etk854hybrid_cdNext.desc: Settings panel: next tab / item (opens the panel when it is closed)

etk854hybrid_cdPress.title: ETK 854: Controller press
etk854hybrid_cdPress.desc: Settings panel: enter the selected tab / run the selected item

etk854hybrid_cdBack.title: ETK 854: Controller back
etk854hybrid_cdBack.desc: Settings panel: back to the tab list, from there close the panel

etk854hybrid_cdViewNext.title: ETK 854: Centre display view
etk854hybrid_cdViewNext.desc: Cycle the centre display view ENERGY / MAP / TRAILER (TRAILER only with trailer data)

etk854hybrid_clusterViewNext.title: ETK 854: Instrument cluster view
etk854hybrid_clusterViewNext.desc: Cycle the instrument cluster view AUTO / HYBRID / EFFICIENCY / SPORT / MINIMAL (AUTO follows the driving experience)

etk854hybrid_cdTouch.onDown: local id = tonumber(VEHICLEID) local v = id and be:getObjectByID(id) or be:getPlayerVehicle(0) if v then local s = core_vehicleTriggers and core_vehicleTriggers.state local p, d if s and s.useCursorCoordinates == false then p = core_camera.getPosition() d = core_camera.getForward() else local r = getCameraMouseRay() if r then p = r.pos d = r.dir end end local o = v:getPosition() if p and d and o then v:queueLuaCommand(string.format([[local c = controller.getController('etk854hybrid_cockpitPanel') if c and c.touchRay then c.touchRay(%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.6f,%.6f,%.6f) end]], p.x - o.x, p.y - o.y, p.z - o.z, d.x, d.y, d.z)) end end
etk854hybrid_cdTouch.title: ETK 854: Centre display touch
etk854hybrid_cdTouch.desc: Touch the centre display where the mouse cursor (or the crosshair) points - fired by a click on the screen
